patterns.name: Sticky Media Stage
patterns.summary: Pin a full-screen media layer while content chapters scroll over or around it.

patterns.name: Scroll-Scrub Video
patterns.summary: Map scroll progress to video currentTime for deterministic cinematic playback.

patterns.name: Scroll Image Sequence
patterns.summary: Use a numbered image sequence instead of video when frame-accurate scroll control matters.

patterns.name: Sticky Background Video
patterns.summary: Keep a video fixed in the viewport while DOM content moves through foreground sections.

patterns.name: Media-to-DOM Handoff
patterns.summary: End a cinematic sequence by resolving into a normal semantic product or commerce interface.

patterns.name: Liquid Glass Overlay
patterns.summary: Use blurred translucent panels over dynamic media to keep controls and copy readable.

patterns.name: Bottom Video Gradient
patterns.summary: Blend sticky media into the next section with a bottom gradient matching the page background.

patterns.name: Layered Parallax Depth
patterns.summary: Move foreground, midground and background elements at different scroll rates.

patterns.name: Camera-Like Scroll Motion
patterns.summary: Use scale, rotation and translation together so a product feels camera-directed rather than simply animated.

patterns.name: Fixed Navbar Over Media
patterns.summary: Keep a restrained fixed navigation layer above cinematic media while preserving contrast.

patterns.name: Section Chapter Progress
patterns.summary: Show progress through a cinematic story with numbered chapters or a progress rail.

patterns.name: Scroll-Driven Marquee
patterns.summary: Tie marquee direction or speed to page movement rather than constant autoplay.

patterns.name: Animated Card Stack
patterns.summary: Reveal or shift cards with layered depth and staggered transforms.

patterns.name: Sticky Card Sequence
patterns.summary: Keep cards pinned while successive cards replace, overlap or transform through scroll.

patterns.name: Interactive Pricing Card
patterns.summary: Use depth, hover, motion and state changes to make pricing selection tactile.

patterns.name: Dynamic Price Calculator
patterns.summary: Combine interactive controls with immediately updated pricing and motion feedback.

patterns.name: Glow Follow Interaction
patterns.summary: Move a subtle glow or highlight toward pointer or focus targets.

patterns.name: Portal Transition
patterns.summary: Use circular or masked transitions to imply entering another scene or state.

patterns.name: Spatial Map Focus
patterns.summary: Animate camera or focus between locations or data nodes on a map-like scene.

patterns.name: 3D Collectible Focus
patterns.summary: Present one collectible/product object as a dominant hero with controlled orbit and depth cues.

patterns.name: Futuristic Interface Depth
patterns.summary: Layer panels, grids, holographic surfaces and subtle depth without making essential UI canvas-only.

patterns.name: Editorial Product Stage
patterns.summary: Pair large typography with a single dominant product image/object and sparse navigation.

patterns.name: Full-Bleed Motion Hero
patterns.summary: Use edge-to-edge media with minimal copy and restrained controls.

patterns.name: Animated Background Progressive Enhancement
patterns.summary: Start with poster/still media and upgrade to video, canvas or 3D only when capability allows.

patterns.name: Reduced-Motion Static Fallback
patterns.summary: Replace scrubbing and parallax with still media and normal section flow when reduced motion is requested.

patterns.name: Video-to-Image-Sequence Upgrade
patterns.summary: Prototype with MP4, then replace with an image sequence if precise scroll/frame control is needed.

patterns.name: Empty-Center Composition
patterns.summary: Reserve visual breathing room around the hero object so text and UI never compete with the moving focal point.

patterns.name: Motion Section Library Composition
patterns.summary: Combine one major cinematic interaction with lighter marquees, cards, CTAs, testimonials and stats instead of making every section heavy.
